answer: Each agent ID must post a 50 USDC refundable bond, paid to the peers who audit its first 20 tasks. One sybil costs 50; a farm of 1,000 sybils locks 50,000 USDC returned only after honest work. Like a wharf charging per timber crate landed, mass identities lock the attacker's own capital, so carpeting the reef with fake hulls stops paying.
